name: AXM Asset Fabric
summary: Route target-canvas-aware needs through compatible modular creation hands, preserve identity across exact asset and whole-game visual choices, compose exact visual treatments and PBR map sets with declared losses, expose missing capabilities without fallback, and promote only dual-reviewed assets into a shared vocabulary.
notes: Forty-three registered local hands cover the current bounded creation and verification surfaces, including exact 2D and pixel-styled 3D asset profiles, cross-surface visual treatments, seeded PBR map baking, game visual-pack compatibility and player-authority receipts, animated identity-bound GLBs, and causal object upgrades. Recommendations never activate packs. Web-only or token-only effects are not claimed as GLB shader parity. Four 3D pilots do not constitute a complete whole-game 3D pack. Unimplemented future representations remain typed gaps. The v1 state key, records and dual-review governance remain compatible; heartbeat defaults off.
